text:
maya: Quick UX pass — routing editor feels cluttered when there are many rules. Can we list a few minimal changes to improve scanability?

jordan: Agree. Quick wins: sticky priority column, compact row option, and clearer reorder affordance.

sam: Copy: tone down error language. 'No match' should be 'No rules matched the preview. Try relaxing conditions.'

taylor: Move the simulator control next to the preview header. Add a small live vs snapshot toggle.

lee: A11y: drag handle contrast low. Recommend darker icon + visible focus ring. Also implement keyboard reorder (Space to grab, arrows to move, Space to drop).

harper: Long condition strings truncating is painful. Suggest wrap + subtle gradient fade with hover-to-expand.

design-bot: Checklist added: sticky numbers, compact/comfortable rows, drag contrast+focus, keyboard reorder pattern, preview live region, soften validation copy.

maya: I'll make two small mocks (compact vs roomy) and an HTML demo for keyboard reorder. ETA: EOD Thursday.

jordan: Please show focus states and contrast variants in the mocks. I'll schedule a 20-min review Friday. :calendar:
